problem_statement.task: Verify page renders and layout is stable
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Open the website. 2. Verify there are no critical console errors blocking render. 3. Ensure the background pattern and main content containers are visible.
problem_statement.expected_result: Page loads fully with no blocking errors, displaying the striped background and central content.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if page loads and displays core elements; fail if rendering crashes or severe console errors occur.

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Locate the sidebar navigation menu. 2. Hover over the 'Home' link. 3. Observe any visual changes. 4. Hover over the 'Contact Us' link.
problem_statement.expected_result: Based on 'home.png', hovering over 'Home' might show a red outline (indicator 1) or 'Contact Us' might show a blue outline (indicator 2) if these are interactive states and not just annotations.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if interactive states match the visual indicators if they are meant to be hover/focus states; deduct points if navigation is static without interactive feedback.

problem_statement.task: Verify search form exists on index/home pages
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Navigate to the Home page ('index.html.png'). 2. Locate the search input field below the header. 3. Locate the 'Search' button next to it.
problem_statement.expected_result: The search input field and 'Search' button should be present on the home page as shown in the screenshot.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if both elements are present; fail if missing.
